issues.reason: "Of mire-essence" is a stated restriction on the vessels and it leaves no trace whatever in the parse, which Core patterns forbids ("a stated restriction, hedge or qualifier is never silently dropped - carry it, or leave the whole claim out and record the gap"); the substance the clause is actually about becomes unqueryable, and "a typical day yields several vessels" is the unqualified assertion the rule bars.

gaps_confirmed: a container / measure of-phrase ("several vessels of mire-essence", the "a cup of water" case): explicitly excluded from the possessive-of mapping, not a partitive (no "of the", no definite superset), and no replacement encoding is named
new_gaps: a VAGUE count of container-units of a mass fits neither channel: CardinalityPhrase counts the containers and loses the substance, while the Measure family needs a numeric magnitude before a container unit could serve; a licensed form would have to carry "a several-vessel quantity OF mire-essence" as one measured thing
defect_summary: The nearest licensed carry is the entity-attached surface-preposition oblique on the vessels' own symbol - (Of sk_vessel_1 mire_essence) - the shape the instruction set licenses for a nominalization's of-argument and for entity-attached From / On; the instruction set names it only for those cases, so the container reading itself is filed as a gap.
notes: The witness route for the indefinite "a typical day" under a verbal predicate, the un-fused descriptive "typical" attached by Member, Agent on the inanimate transitive subject, GroupOf + CardinalityPhrase for the vague "several", and the absent status atom on the generic present are all correct.
